questions.stem: We ____ (have) a maths test next Monday.

options.distractor: next Monday 是将来，不能直接用现在时

questions.explanation: next Monday 表示将来，用 will have。

questions.stem: She ____ (be) thirteen years old next year.
questions.explanation: be 动词的将来时是 will be，不管主语是谁。

questions.stem: ____ you ____ (come) to my birthday party tomorrow?

options.distractor: tomorrow 表示将来，不能用一般现在时
come 是实义动词，不能与 are 连用
will 后面要用原形 come

questions.explanation: 将来时的疑问句：Will + 主语 + 动词原形。

questions.stem: They ____ (not go) to school tomorrow because it's Saturday.

options.distractor: will not 的缩写是 won't，不是 willn't

questions.explanation: 将来时否定用 won't（= will not）+ 动词原形。
I think 之后是对将来的预测，用 will rain。

questions.stem: He ____ (be) a doctor when he grows up.
questions.explanation: when he grows up 指的是将来，主句用 will be。

questions.stem: There ____ (be) a class meeting this afternoon.

options.distractor: this afternoon 还没到，表示将来
there be 句型将来时应为 there will be

questions.explanation: there be 句型的将来时是 there will be（不用 there will have）。

questions.stem: — What ____ you ____ (do) this weekend? — I ____ my grandparents.

options.distractor: this weekend 表示将来，不是习惯
do 是实义动词，疑问要用 will

questions.explanation: 问句和答语说的都是这个周末的计划，两处都用将来时。

options.text: I'll help you with your bag.
Look at the sky! It will snow.
We are going to have a party.

questions.explanation: “看天色”说明眼前有迹象，必须用 is going to snow，不能用 will。

options.text: He will goes to Beijing next week.
She is going to study hard.
I'm going to visit my aunt.

questions.explanation: will 后面必须接动词原形 go，不能接 goes。

questions.stem: — Why are you taking an umbrella? — Because it ____ rain.

options.distractor: 带伞说明已经有了判断依据
结构不完整，going 后要有 to

questions.explanation: 已经带伞说明有迹象/早有判断，用 is going to rain 更贴切。

questions.stem: If it ____ (rain) tomorrow, we ____ (stay) at home.

options.distractor: if 引导的条件从句不能用将来时
主句表示将来的结果，要用 will stay
从句不能用将来时（主将从现）

questions.explanation: 主将从现：if 从句用一般现在时 rains，主句用 will stay。

questions.stem: — What are you going to do this Sunday? — I ____ visit my grandma.

options.distractor: 问句用了 be going to，答语保持一致更自然

questions.explanation: be going to 的完整结构是 am/is/are going to + 动词原形。

questions.stem: They ____ (have) a picnic tomorrow. Everything is ready.

options.distractor: tomorrow 表示将来，不能直接用现在时
主语 They 是复数，be 动词用 are

questions.explanation: 东西都准备好了，是事先打算好的事，用 are going to have。

options.text: They are going to have a meeting tomorrow.
They going to have a meeting tomorrow.
They are going have a meeting tomorrow.
They is going to have a meeting tomorrow.
options.distractor: They 是复数，be 动词用 are

questions.explanation: be going to 三要素缺一不可：be 动词 + going to + 动词原形。

questions.stem: — ____ you ____ (watch) the match tonight? — Yes, I've got the ticket.

options.distractor: tonight 表示将来，不是习惯动作
will 后面要用动词原形

questions.explanation: 票都拿到了，是事先计划好的事，用 Are you going to watch。

options.text: Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
We're going to visit the museum next week.
He is going to goes home now.
I'm going to be a teacher when I grow up.

questions.explanation: be going to 后面必须接动词原形 go，不能接 goes。

questions.stem: — The box is too heavy. — I ____ help you.　— Look at that big black cloud. — It ____ rain.

options.distractor: 第一空是听到后才做的决定，用 will
第二空眼前有乌云这个迹象，要用 is going to

options.text: am going to; is going to
options.distractor: 第一空是临时决定，用 will

questions.explanation: 临时决定用 will；眼前有迹象（乌云）用 be going to。
